mira: ok team urgent scientific question — who else’s toast launches itself if you set it to ‘crisp + moonlight’? :thinking:

giphy-bot: *GIPHY* — posted a 3s loop (space-toast-moonwalk.gif) https://giphy.com/gifs/space-toast-moonwalk

alex: HAHAHA what is that even :joy:

sam: that gif is illegal, i want like 12

tess: omg that looks exactly like my toaster when i tried the ‘sourdough experiment’ last week :exploding_head:

giphy-bot: :thumbsup: (reaction)

mira: sending to facilities to check microwave-toaster wormhole theory @sam do you have the clip?

sam: sadly i only have a potato. also this: :rocket: :bread:

alex: :laughing: :laughing:

tess: vote: keep toaster or send to space? React with :+1: to keep, :shipit: to send 

mira: poll over — looks like :shipit: wins so we’re scheduling a ceremonial launch at lunch :tada:

sam: pls stream, i will bring celebratory jam

alex: i demand a halftime halftime show from the janitor band :drum:

mira: noted. archival footage will be added to the company time capsule. :camera_with_flash:

(tiny thread, mostly reactions and gifs)
